exam_structure_old_formula.2005-2006 (A1/A2 arkusze): Arkusz I (MHI-P1A1P-05x/06x, 120 min, 100 pts, ~34-40 tasks: short sources + questions across all epochs) = poziom podstawowy. Arkusz II (MHI-R1A1P, 150 min, 50 pts): one theme; part 1 = source analysis tasks (30 pts), part 2 = one extended-answer essay (20 pts). Rozszerzony candidates wrote BOTH A1 and A2. Task numbering in A2 continues from A1 (e.g. 35-51 in 2005, 41-60 in 2005-12/2006-01).
exam_structure_old_formula.2007-2014 and 2015-2020 stara: P (MHI-P1_1P-YYs, 120 min, 100 pts, ~28-40 numbered tasks, most with lettered sub-parts A/B/C; from ~2015 sub-tasks numbered 2.1, 2.2). R (MHI-R1_1P, 180 min, 50 pts): CZĘŚĆ I test (20 pts), CZĘŚĆ II analiza źródeł (10 pts, sources labelled Źródło A/B/...), CZĘŚĆ III wypracowanie (20 pts, choose 1 of 2-3 topics, scored by levels I-IV).
exam_structure_old_formula.2003 pilot (OKE Wrocław): Arkusz I (60 min; key says 90 raw pts divided by 3 in Jan, 30 pts in May), Arkusz II (90 min, 40 pts) and Arkusz III (90 min, 30 pts) each in 3 epoch variants (a/b/c) - candidate chose one epoch. Continuous task numbering across I->II->III.
exam_structure_old_formula.session code: Last 3 digits of the arkusz code = YY + session digit (2 = May, 1 = January/winter, 3 = June), e.g. MHI-P1_1P-123 = czerwiec 2012. 7P = deaf variant.

parser_notes.sources: No separate source booklet in any old-formula paper: all sources (texts, maps, images, tables) are printed inside the arkusz next to their task. R part II sources (Źródło A, B...) are shared by several tasks. Informatyka-style separate attachments do not occur for historia. 2005 A1 also exists as a ZIP on CKE/OKE Poznań (not downloaded).

answer_key_formats.2003 pilot: Plain numbered paragraphs ('32. ... - 1 pkt. Łącznie maksymalnie 2 pkt.'), per-task point rules in prose.
answer_key_formats.2005-2006 (+ grudzień 2005, styczeń 2006: Table 'MODEL ODPOWIEDZI I SCHEMAT OCENIANIA': columns = nr zadania | część zadania (A/B) | model odpowiedzi | punkty za część | punkty za całe zadanie; rows often split across pages; general scoring rules on page 1; essay level descriptors (I-IV, 0-20 pts) at the end of A2 key. pymupdf find_tables() detects these tables.
answer_key_formats.2006 maj, 2007, 2008 (+ deaf variants): NO separate rubric: 'przykład rozwiązania' = the full arkusz with model answers typed in blue italics inside the answer spaces (kind=rozwiazany). Answers must be extracted as the text that is absent from the blank arkusz (diff against the matching *-arkusz.pdf, or use span colour/italic font flags). Max points only from '(n pkt)' in task headers; R essay part contains a model essay, no level criteria.
answer_key_formats.2009: Single 'KLUCZ PUNKTOWANIA ODPOWIEDZI' file for BOTH levels (P first, 'POZIOM ROZSZERZONY' starts ~halfway); per task: area of standards + requirement + '0-n' + 'Zdający otrzymuje ... punkt' + 'Poprawne odpowiedzi:'. Deaf key separate.
answer_key_formats.2010-2014: 'Kryteria oceniania odpowiedzi' / 'Rozwiązania zadań i schemat punktowania': per task 'Zadanie N. (0-k)', sub-parts 'A. (0-1)', a table row with Obszar standardów | Opis wymagań (standard code e.g. II 5), then 'Poprawna odpowiedź:' or 'Przykłady poprawnych odpowiedzi:' (bullet list) and 'n p. - za ...' lines. R essay: 4 levels per topic - Poziom I (1-5 p.), II (6-10), III (11-15), IV (16-20); 0 if below level I.
answer_key_formats.2015-2020 stara: Same family as formula 2015 zasady: 'Zadanie N. (0-k)' + requirement text + 'Schemat punktowania' (n p. / 0 p.) + 'Poprawna odpowiedź' / 'Przykładowe odpowiedzi'; sub-tasks N.1, N.2. Close to the existing formula-2015 parser.
answer_key_formats.formula 2015 extras (grudzień 2013 przyk: Standard formula-2015 'Rozwiązania zadań i schematy punktowania' / 'Zasady oceniania' - existing f2015 parser should work; 2024 EHIP has a separate karta odpowiedzi.

text_layer_issues: 2003 pilot PDFs: Polish diacritics are partly or wholly missing in the text layer (esp. maj 2003 arkusze and styczeń 2003 A3 arkusze: 'Prosz sprawdzi' for 'Proszę sprawdzić'); needs OCR or font-mapping fix.
Older PDFs (2005-2009) extract with spaced diacritics from pypdf ('zg łoś', 'Sprawd ź'); pymupdf extraction is clean - prefer pymupdf.
All other files have a usable text layer (no scanned-only files detected); pictures/maps are embedded images.
parser_notes.dedup_and_variants: No file is byte-identical to anything in datasets/local/matura-historia. Deaf (-ns) variants mostly reuse the standard tasks with simplified wording - treat as near-duplicates of P when splitting train/test. 2025/2026 informators and their dwujęzyczne versions overlap heavily with each other and with the 2023 informator (same sample tasks re-used). Zbiór zadań f2015: tasks in cz1 + start of cz2, then 'Wskazówki do rozwiązania zadań' and solutions in cz2.
parser_notes.point_totals: stara P = 100 pts / 120 min; stara R = 50 pts / 180 min (20 test + 10 sources + 20 essay); 2005-06 A1 = 100 pts / 120 min, A2 = 50 pts / 150 min; formula 2015 R = 50 pts / 180 min; formula 2023 R = 60 pts.
